command: for i in enp1s0f1np1 enP2p1s0f1np1; do echo INTERFACE=$i; ip -s -s link show dev "$i"; ethtool -S "$i"; done; for d in rocep1s0f1 roceP2p1s0f1; do for f in /sys/class/infiniband/$d/ports/1/counters/* /sys/class/infiniband/$d/ports/1/hw_counters/*; do echo FILE=$f; cat "$f"; done; done; rdma resource show cm_id; ps -C ib_write_bw -o pid,stat,args; test -z "$(pgrep -x ib_write_bw)"
